hero.title: From complex workflows to working systems.
hero.description: I'm Dino Lozina, founder of Akritech. I build applications end to end — from the interface and backend to integrations, deployment, and production operations. My work spans conversational AI, distributed platforms, and developer tools.
hero.location: Based in Split, Croatia · Working remotely

work.title: Built, shipped, and operated.
work.introduction: Workflow orchestration, voice infrastructure, secure integrations, and cloud platforms — selected work from design through production.

projects.title: Workflows that recover from failure
projects.summary: Founded a service for multi-step workflows connecting calls, messages, waits, and human review. Built conditional routing, retry and resume, bulk recovery, and operational monitoring.
projects.result: Work can resume after failures, with automatic retries when a provider recovers and visibility into tasks that need attention.

projects.title: The infrastructure behind the conversation
projects.summary: Extracted telephony from a larger application into a regional service owning phone-number registries, number pools, and outbound calling. Built number-management tools and integrated voice and SMS into the wider platform.
projects.result: A dedicated production service with clear ownership of calling infrastructure and the tools to manage it.

projects.title: Connecting AI to real operational work
projects.summary: Delivered an after-hours callback integration from design through production, including secure event delivery, human approval, recording and transcript exports, and knowledge-base synchronization.
projects.result: Conversation outputs move into downstream systems through an auditable workflow with a human review gate.

projects.title: Cloud platforms developers can build on
projects.summary: Designed and implemented serverless execution and JavaScript offloading services. Built SDKs, command-line tools, API libraries, and documentation, and led distributed engineering teams through architecture and delivery.
projects.result: Experience across both the distributed platform and the interfaces developers use to work with it.

about.title: Hi, I'm Dino.
paragraphs: I'm a software engineer based in Split, Croatia. I started in industrial automation, programming machines and robotic systems, and moved into developer tools, distributed cloud platforms, and conversational AI.

That path shapes how I work: understand the system, make its behavior explicit, and take responsibility for what happens after it ships. I combine hands-on implementation with architecture, technical leadership, and code review.
Alongside engineering, I've taught robotics and advanced control systems and authored educational books on robotics. Akritech is my software engineering consultancy, established in 2022.
